issue.title: Returning online and synchronizing changes Audit
issue.body:
Audit the Returning online and synchronizing changes against related GitHub issues and expected behavior. Test the latest supported mobile build, document results, and create `dev ready` issues for any identified gaps.

**Done when:** The assessment is merged, all gaps are linked to actionable issues, and the audit result is posted to this sub-ticket.

comments.body: ⚠️ Wait for the merge of https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/559 to avoid rework. This PR has important changes to be considered for this audit.

## Returning online and synchronizing changes audit — result

**Overall:** Fail

**Assessment PR (draft):** #598

**Doc:** `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md`

**Build/env:** local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head, on top of `main` @ `fb634e5`); B.7 and the second H.24 device used the nightly `1.0.0` of `main`. API: `https://dev.api.fluent.bible`.

**Why this build:** we tested the head of PR #559 (#546) instead of the nightly because that PR was still waiting for approval and contains changes this audit depends on: one Wi-Fi / cellular transport rule for upload and download, the blocked-transport copy on the Sync page, and the split between link-layer connectivity and Fluent `/health` reachability. Testing `main` alone would have audited transport behavior that #559 replaces. The assessment PR (#598) itself branches from `main`, since the document does not depend on #559's code.

**Device:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), physical device.

**Summary:** The core reconnect path works: takes recorded offline upload on their own when Wi-Fi returns, the cellular gate from PR #559 holds, Pause / Resume / Cancel / Sync Now behave as specified, an app kill resumes the upload, and the Downloads section renders. The sync is not reliable enough to trust yet. The upload notification crashes the app (#599; one reconnect starts several concurrent upload sessions, a race that PR #559 widens), an offline "Send to Peer Check" silently reverts to Draft and never reaches the server (#257), and takes in a chapter claimed offline fail with a 404 until the user deletes them (#611, filed by the #533 audit; evidence on #271). These three are High and need a launch-blocker decision with product before the November 2026 ETEN Summit. The rest degrade trust in the sync UI: stale reachability, wrong progress counts, stale sync errors, a header icon that differs per screen (no shared sync state), failures shown for a normal connection drop, takes recorded online that never upload, and a missing "All synced" state. Conflict detection (H.24) could not be tested and stays open.

| Gap | Finding | Severity | Launch blocker | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Upload foreground service crashes the app | High | To be decided with product | #599 |
| 2 | Upload progress counts takes and contradicts the page state | Medium | No | #600 |
| 3 | Server reachability goes stale after reconnect and on cold start | Medium | No | #601 |
| 4 | Network failures stay on the Sync page as sync errors | Low | No | #602 |
| 5 | Header sync icon is stale and uses the wrong offline glyph | Medium | No | #603 |
| 6 | Connection drop mid-upload marks takes failed with a raw error | Medium | No | #604 |
| 7 | Takes recorded while already online never upload | Medium | No | #605 |
| 8 | Offline stage advance lost on reconnect | High | To be decided with product | #257 (comment) |
| 9 | Takes in a chapter claimed offline fail with 404 | High | To be decided with product | #611 (from #533; evidence also on #271 comment) |
| 10 | Back from Manage downloads needs two taps | Low | No | #147 (comment) |
| 11 | Sync page never reaches "All synced" | Low | No | #147 (comment) |

Will post the merged assessment link here after #598 merges.

## Returning online and synchronizing changes audit — tests executed

These are the tests run to reach the results and gaps in this audit.

All tests were run on a physical Android device with access to Wi-Fi and mobile data.

### A. Baseline

- **A.1** Online on Wi-Fi, nothing pending. Expected: header green `cloud-check`; Sync page "Upload complete" / "All synced", no controls.
- **A.2** Airplane mode, nothing pending. Expected: header gray `cloud-check`.

### B. Coming back online with takes recorded offline

- **B.3** In airplane mode, record takes in 2+ chapters, several verses each. Expected: header gray pending variant; chapter rows show pending.
- **B.4** Still offline, open the Sync page. Expected: offline copy; Sync Now not actionable, with a reason.
- **B.5** Back on Home, turn airplane mode off (Wi-Fi only, toggle off) and do nothing. Expected: upload starts on its own, no prompt; header shows syncing.
- **B.6** Open the Sync page during the upload. Expected: animated icon; "Uploading"; "X of Y chapters uploaded" with Y = chapters, never going backwards; Pause + Cancel.
- **B.7** Background the app during the upload. Expected: one persistent notification "Uploading your recordings" / "X of Y chapters uploaded", no flicker between chapters; tap opens Sync.
- **B.8** Let the upload finish. Expected: notification clears; "Upload complete"; header green `cloud-check`; chapter rows synced.

### C. Transport rule (a new take recorded offline before each step)

- **C.9** Wi-Fi off, mobile data on, toggle off. Expected: no upload; Sync Now disabled with "Connect to WiFi to sync, or enable cellular uploads in Settings.".
- **C.10** Turn the toggle on. Expected: upload starts on its own.
- **C.11** Toggle off again, take pending, turn Wi-Fi on. Expected: upload starts on its own.

### D. Controls (several takes pending so the upload lasts)

- **D.12** While syncing, tap Pause. Expected: bar frozen; "Paused"; "Resumes automatically in …"; Resume + Sync Now + Cancel; notification clears.
- **D.13** While paused, airplane mode on, then off. Expected: stays paused, no upload (24 h window).
- **D.14** Tap Resume (or Sync Now). Expected: upload restarts; pause window cleared.
- **D.15** While syncing, tap Cancel. Expected: stops at once; Sync Now shown; no automatic retry while connectivity stays the same.
- **D.16** After Cancel, airplane mode on, then off. Expected: auto-upload fires again.

### E. Interruptions

- **E.17** While syncing, airplane mode on for 30 s, then off. Expected: silent pause, no failed state or error; resumes on its own.
- **E.18** While syncing, kill the app and relaunch online. Expected: upload resumes; no take stuck "uploading".
- **E.19** Already online, record a new take and wait on Home without touching Sync. Expected: the take uploads with no action.

### F. Failures

- **F.20** A take failed (E.17 produced one); check Sync. Expected: the failure reason is shown and clears after a successful retry.
- **F.21** After "Upload complete", check the pending count. Expected: zero pending; header turns green.

### G. Other offline changes

- **G.22** In airplane mode, on a chapter with every verse recorded, last verse → "Send to Peer Check" → Send. Then Wi-Fi on, open Sync, Sync Now; check My Work, Projects and the web app as PM. Expected: the stage reaches the server; the local stage does not revert.
- **G.23** Offline, record a take in an unassigned chapter (claimed on first recording), then reconnect. Expected: the claim reaches the server and the take uploads.

### H. Conflicts (two devices)

- **H.24** Same drafter account on both devices, Sync Now on each; both in airplane mode; record the same verse on each; reconnect device A and wait for its upload, then reconnect device B. Expected: conflict indicator (`users` + `triangle-alert`) on the chapter row; no silent overwrite.

### I. Downloads on reconnect

- **I.25** Online, start a Prepare for Offline download for a chapter not yet downloaded, then Pause; record one take; airplane mode on, then off; open Sync. Expected: Downloads section below the controls with progress, "N items remaining" and "Manage downloads"; Manage downloads opens Prepare for Offline and one back returns to Sync; the section hides when the queue is empty.
- **I.26** Let uploads and downloads finish. Expected: "All synced" in place of the progress bar, `cloud-check`, no controls.

## Additional findings after the audit

Found in a re-test on 2026-09-30:

- **The Sync page can show "All synced" when the app fails to read pending uploads.** → #620
- **The Sync icon briefly flashes "pending" before "All synced".** → #621
- **Signing out from the side menu does not warn about recordings that were not uploaded.** The "Log out" option in More Settings does warn, and the two options have different names ("Log out" / "Sign Out"). → #622

@Roslin22

## Returning online and synchronizing changes — retest

> **Note:** this test script was generated with the help of AI, from the tests executed in the #530 audit (epic #526) and from other information gathered while the issues were implemented. It is a guide, not a limit: any other test that covers these points or goes beyond them is also valid.

> **Linked issues:** when a test ends with an issue number in parentheses, for example `(#603)` at the end of A.2, that is the sub-issue that fixed that point, so you can open it to see what was changed. Some of these issues are still open or depend on work that is not finished yet (for example, fluent-api changes). Those tests are marked with "issue still open" or "may fail". For them, a failure may be expected for now: report what you see, but it does not necessarily mean the fix regressed.

"Cloud icon" is the icon in the top-right corner that shows the sync state; tapping it opens the **Sync** page. "Cellular option" is "Upload/Download over cellular" in Settings.

How the cloud icon should look:
- **Online, everything uploaded:** cloud with a green check.
- **Online, uploading:** cloud with green spinning arrows.
- **Online, upload waiting:** cloud with a yellow up arrow.
- **Online, upload failed:** cloud with a red up arrow.
- **Offline, nothing waiting:** gray cloud with a check.
- **Offline, items waiting:** gray crossed-out cloud.

**What to prepare:** a phone with a mobile data SIM; an account with assigned chapters (2 or more); access to the web app as PM; for H.24, two phones with the same account; a project with pericopes (for J.2).

### A. Starting state

- [ ] **A.1** Open the app online on Wi-Fi, with no recordings waiting. Expected: the cloud icon opens already green with a check (it does not start gray); the Sync page shows "Upload complete" / "All synced", with no buttons. (#603, #601)
- [ ] **A.2** In airplane mode, with nothing waiting. Expected: gray cloud with a check. (#603)
- [ ] **A.3** In airplane mode, record a take and go back. Look at the icon on Home, My Work, the chapter screen and the Sync page. Then delete that take and look again. Expected: the icon is the same on every screen and changes at once (waiting after recording, nothing waiting after deleting), without closing and opening the app. (#603)

### B. Coming back online with recordings made offline

- [ ] **B.3** In airplane mode, record takes in 2 or more chapters, several verses each. Expected: gray crossed-out cloud; in the list, the chapters show they have uploads waiting. (#603)
- [ ] **B.4** Still offline, open the Sync page. Expected: an offline message; the Sync Now button does not work and shows the reason.
- [ ] **B.5** Go back to Home, turn airplane mode off (Wi-Fi only, cellular option off) and do not touch anything. Expected: the upload starts on its own, with no question, and the cloud icon shows the green arrows. (#601)
- [ ] **B.6** Open the Sync page during the upload. Expected: animated icon; "Uploading"; "X of Y chapters uploaded", where Y is the number of chapters and X never goes down or above Y; Pause and Cancel buttons. (#600)
- [ ] **B.6b** In the middle of the upload, close the app from recent apps and open it again. Expected: the count is still in chapters and never goes above 100% (e.g. never "8 of 3"). (#600)
- [ ] **B.7** During the upload, press Home to put the app in the background. Expected: a single notification "Uploading your recordings" / "X of Y chapters uploaded", not flashing at each chapter; tapping it opens the Sync page; **the app does not close on its own**. (#599 — issue still open, #600)
- [ ] **B.8** Wait for the upload to finish. Expected: the notification disappears; "Upload complete" is shown; the cloud icon turns green with a check, without flashing "waiting" first; the chapters show as synced. (#603, #621)
- [ ] **B.9** In airplane mode, record a single take in **one** chapter and turn airplane mode off with the app open. Repeat with the app in the background. Expected: the take uploads and the app does not close on its own. (#599 — issue still open)

### C. Wi-Fi / mobile data rule (record a new take offline before each step)

- [ ] **C.9** Wi-Fi off, mobile data on, cellular option off. Expected: nothing uploads; Sync Now is disabled with the message "Connect to WiFi to sync, or enable cellular uploads in Settings.".
- [ ] **C.10** Turn the cellular option on. Expected: the upload starts on its own, without opening the Sync page. (#601)
- [ ] **C.11** Turn the cellular option off again, with a take waiting, and turn Wi-Fi on. Expected: the upload starts on its own. (#601)

### D. Sync page buttons (with several takes waiting, so the upload takes a while)

- [ ] **D.12** During the upload, tap Pause. Expected: the bar stops; "Paused" and "Resumes automatically in …" are shown; Resume, Sync Now and Cancel appear; the notification disappears; the text at the top does **not** say "all synced" while paused. (#600)
- [ ] **D.13** With the upload paused, turn airplane mode on and off. Expected: it stays paused, nothing uploads.
- [ ] **D.14** Tap Resume (or Sync Now) right after turning airplane mode off. Expected: the buttons work ("Can't reach Fluent" is not shown) and the upload starts again. (#601)
- [ ] **D.15** During the upload, tap Cancel. Expected: it stops at once; the Sync Now button appears; it does not retry on its own while the connection stays the same.
- [ ] **D.16** After Cancel, turn airplane mode on and off. Expected: the upload starts on its own again.

### E. Interruptions

- [ ] **E.17** During the upload, turn on airplane mode for 30 seconds and turn it off. Expected: the upload pauses without showing an error or failure, and continues on its own when internet returns. (#604, #601)
- [ ] **E.18** During the upload, close the app from recent apps and open it again with internet. Expected: the upload continues; no take stays stuck as "uploading"; the app does not close on its own. (#599 — issue still open)
- [ ] **E.19** Already online, record a new take and stay on Home without opening Sync. Expected: the take uploads on its own shortly. (#605)
- [ ] **E.20** If any upload shows an error during these tests, tap Sync Now. Expected: the upload starts again at once, without closing and opening the app. (#601)

### F. Failures

- [ ] **F.20** Online, tap Sync Now and turn Wi-Fi off right after. Turn Wi-Fi back on and let the sync finish. Expected: messages like "Sync failed: master data" do **not** stay on the Sync page once sync works again, and being offline is shown as offline, not as a failure. (#602)
- [ ] **F.21** After "Upload complete", look at the number of items waiting. Expected: zero waiting; green cloud with a check.

### G. Other changes made offline

- [ ] **G.22** In airplane mode, in a chapter with every verse recorded, go to the last verse → "Send to Peer Check" → Send. Turn Wi-Fi on, open Sync and tap Sync Now. Check My Work, Projects and, on the web app, as PM. Expected: the chapter shows in Peer Check on the web, and in the app it does not go back to Draft. (#257 — issue still open, expected to fail until it is built)
- [ ] **G.23** Offline, record a take in a chapter not assigned to anyone (the app assigns the chapter to you on the first recording), then bring internet back. Expected: on the web, the chapter shows as assigned to you, and the take uploads with no error. (#611)

### H. Conflict (two phones)

- [ ] **H.24** Same account on two phones, Sync Now on each. Put both in airplane mode and record the same verse on each. Bring internet back on phone A and wait for the upload; then bring internet back on phone B. Expected: the chapter shows the conflict icon (two people with a warning triangle), and no recording is replaced without warning. (could not be tested in the original audit)

### I. Downloads when coming back online

- [ ] **I.25** Online, start a Prepare for Offline download of a chapter not yet downloaded and pause it. Record a take. Turn airplane mode on and off. Open Sync. Expected: a Downloads section appears below the buttons, with progress, "N items remaining" and "Manage downloads"; "Manage downloads" opens Prepare for Offline, and **one** tap on back returns to Sync; the section disappears when there are no more downloads. (#147)
- [ ] **I.26** Let uploads and downloads finish. Expected: "All synced" is shown in place of the progress bar, cloud with a check, no buttons. (#147)
- [ ] **I.27** In the Downloads section, look at each item's name. Expected: items show the right names (Source Bible, Audio, Text, Translation Notes, Translation Words). (#147)
- [ ] **I.28** With a download in progress, start downloading another chapter in Prepare for Offline and go back to Sync. Expected: the new download joins the queue, and the progress bar and item count update. (#147)
- [ ] **I.29** Cancel a download in progress. Expected: it leaves the queue and "N items remaining" goes down. (#147)
- [ ] **I.30** With the cellular option on, start downloads on a weak mobile data signal, then connect to Wi-Fi. Expected: the downloads continue on their own on Wi-Fi, without starting them again. (#147)

### J. Found after the audit

- [ ] **J.1** With takes not yet uploaded, open the side menu and tap Sign Out. Expected: the same unsent-recordings warning shown in More Settings → Log out appears, and both options have the same name. (#622)
- [ ] **J.2** With **only pericope takes** not yet uploaded (Pericope mode), repeat J.1 and also More Settings → Log out. Expected: both warnings appear. (#622)

### Engineering check (QA can skip)

- [ ] **X.1** A failure reading the waiting recordings must not show as "All synced". It cannot be reproduced on the phone; it is checked by the automated tests. (#620)
